params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the number of objects in the output. (default value: 100, maximum value: 500).

params.name: offset
params.description: Used to retrieve all objects from a certain offset up to the. (default value: 0).

params.name: type
params.description: DNS zone type (master or slave).

params.name: name_pattern
params.description: DNS zone name pattern. Wildcard (*) can be used.

params.description: Indicates, whether DNS records should be displayed in output.

params.name: with_history
params.description: Indicates, whether DNS zone history should be displayed in output.
